slides.title:
A *tractor maker*
complained to Enzo
Ferrari. So he built
Lamborghini. 🚜
slides.sub: The revenge story behind the bull 👇

slides.title:
Ferruccio Lamborghini is
born into a *farming family*
near Ferrara, Italy.
slides.sub:
April 28, 1916, in Renazzo. He trains
as a mechanic (Motor Valley).

slides.title:
After the war, he builds
tractors from *leftover
military hardware*.
slides.sub:
Lamborghini Trattori, Cento. Early 1960s:
~400 staff, ~30 tractors a day (Motor Valley).

slides.title:
He's rich. He drives Ferraris.
But the clutch *keeps slipping*
when he pushes hard.
slides.sub:
Each repair at Maranello took hours,
and he wasn't allowed to watch.

slides.title:
He tells Enzo Ferrari his
cars are rubbish. The reply:
*stick to tractors*.
slides.sub:
“You may be able to drive a tractor but you
will never be able to handle a Ferrari
properly.” (as Ferruccio told it in 1991)

slides.title: This was the point when I finally decided to make a *perfect car*.
slides.author:
Ferruccio Lamborghini
(Thoroughbred & Classic Cars, 1991)

slides.title:
He founds *Automobili
Lamborghini* and hires an
ex-Ferrari engineer.
slides.sub:
1963: the 350 GTV is shown in Turin.
1966: the Miura stuns Geneva.

slides.title:
